works.title: Maximus the Confessor
works.subtitle: The Early Church Fathers
works.author: Andrew Louth
works.blurb: Louth's introduction with fresh translations of key short works. The standard entry point into Maximus's cosmic Christology.

works.title: On the Cosmic Mystery of Jesus Christ
works.subtitle: Popular Patristics Series
works.author: Maximus the Confessor
works.blurb: Selected Ambigua and Questions to Thalassius translated by Paul Blowers and Robert Wilken, Maximus at his most luminous on the incarnation as the goal of creation.

works.title: Microcosm and Mediator
works.subtitle: The Theological Anthropology of Maximus the Confessor
works.author: Lars Thunberg
works.blurb: Thunberg's classic study of Maximian anthropology, the logoi, the union of natures, the deifying ascent through the modes of human existence. The patristic depth from which Palamas later drew the essence-energies vocabulary.
